admin:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_caller_is_admin()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado: requer papel admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$
roles:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND role = _role
  )
$function$
setter:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_set_store_custom_domains_v2(p_store_id uuid, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO custom_domain_v2_access(store_id, enabled, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (p_store_id, p_enabled, auth.uid(), now())
    ON CONFLICT (store_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now();
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'enabled', p_enabled);
END $function$
reserved:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_reserved_custom_domain(p_domain text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['shopdrive.com.br','virtualmercado.com.br','lovable.app','lovable.dev',
    'lovableproject.com','supabase.co','supabase.in','supabase.com']) r
    WHERE p_domain = r OR p_domain LIKE '%.' || r);
$function$
store_valid:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_public_store_active(_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p
    WHERE p.id = _store_id AND p.store_slug IS NOT NULL
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND coalesce(p.account_status,'active') = 'active')
$function$
